name: income_equality
genetic_identity: Income equality is low dispersion of income across households as summarized by the Gini index — not mean income, urbanization, or poverty headcount alone.

excludes: High GDP/GNI per capita as equality
Poverty headcount alone as Gini equality

rules.name: no_forbidden_proxy
rules.statement: Using forbidden proxy series for success leaves this concept.

rules.name: null_outside_envelope
rules.statement: Missing primary observation is outside envelope, not low fidelity.
